independent_oracles: Exhaustive edge-mask Euler trail search with lexicographic comparison; direct GF(2) matrix exponentiation independent of Krylov polynomial reduction. A maximum 10000-vertex/100000-edge Euler instance independently checks every edge multiplicity and route length; the 1000-dimensional cyclic matrix has analytic query answers.
note: Historical accepted records belong to the original version; no online submission was made for this refactor.

changes.D: vis/pos/st/ans replaced by global bounded arrays; initialization explicitly clears vis/pos and resets top/cnt per input. st and ans each hold at most m+1 entries.
changes.E: expr array renamed f; reduce function renamed rem, preserving all polynomial arithmetic.
